completion_promises.criterion_text: KeycloakIdentityProvider implements the 3-member IdentityProvider port unchanged, with a sync currentPrincipal backed by an in-memory cached principal
completion_promises.evidence: Created KeycloakIdentityProvider in app/lib/adapters/keycloak_identity_provider.dart implementing IdentityProvider with sync currentPrincipal getter, async signIn(), and async signOut(). The currentPrincipal is backed by _currentPrincipal field updated after token operations.

completion_promises.criterion_text: signIn() attempts a silent refresh of the stored session before opening the browser, and opens the interactive PKCE S256 browser flow only when silent refresh is unavailable/fails
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented _performSignIn() that first attempts _silentRefresh() using stored session's refresh token via FlutterAppAuth.token(). On failure or absence of session, falls back to _interactiveSignIn() using authorizeAndExchangeCode(). PKCE S256 is the flutter_appauth default for public clients.

completion_promises.criterion_text: The interactive flow uses KeycloakConfig.redirectUrl (com.appmilla.studytutor:/oauth2redirect) and requests offline_access, and completes after the custom-scheme redirect returns the app to the foreground
completion_promises.evidence: Interactive flow uses AuthorizationTokenRequest with _config.clientId, _config.redirectUrl, _config.issuer, and _config.scopes (which includes 'offline_access'). The KeycloakConfig enforces these values.

completion_promises.criterion_text: signIn() surfaces cancel and failure as distinct outcomes (§4 SIGNIN_OUTCOME) and never conflates them
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented SignInCancelled and SignInFailed as distinct exception types. _interactiveSignIn() catches FlutterAppAuthPlatformException and uses _isCancelError() to distinguish cancel (CANCELED code) from other failures, throwing appropriate exception type.

completion_promises.criterion_text: A second signIn() while one is in flight starts no second flow (single-flight)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented single-flight guard using _signInInFlight field. signIn() checks if a Future is already in flight and returns it instead of starting a new flow. The field is cleared when the Future completes.

completion_promises.criterion_text: The adapter refreshes proactively before access-token expiry using the appauth token-response expiry, so an idle longer than the access-token lifetime does not force a re-sign-in while the offline session is valid (KC-G3)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented _scheduleProactiveRefresh() which schedules a Timer to refresh 5 minutes before expiry using response.accessTokenExpirationDateTime. Called after successful token operations. _performBackgroundRefresh() executes the refresh and updates the cached principal.

completion_promises.criterion_text: signOut() clears the secure store and cached principal and wins over an in-flight background refresh — a refresh completing after sign-out does not restore the session
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented generation-based epoch using _generation counter. signOut() increments _generation, cancels refresh timer, and clears principal and store. All refresh operations capture generation at start and check before updating principal, discarding updates if generation changed.

completion_promises.criterion_text: An unrecoverable background refresh leaves currentPrincipal == null and degrades to the sign-in fallback rather than crashing or hanging
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented _performBackgroundRefresh() with try-catch. On token refresh exception, clears _currentPrincipal and store if generation hasn't changed. Never propagates exceptions to callers of currentPrincipal (which is sync).

completion_promises.criterion_text: At launch an absent/unreadable/offline-expired stored session is treated as signed out
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented _performSignIn() to check storedSession for null and expiry using _isExpired(). If absent, unreadable (SecureSessionStore returns null), or expired, skips silent refresh and goes straight to interactive flow. No initialization code sets principal at launch.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Hermetic tests fake FlutterAppAuth and SecureSessionStore — no browser, no network, no platform channel
completion_promises.evidence: Created FakeAppAuth implementing FlutterAppAuth interface and FakeSecureSessionStore implementing SecureSessionStore interface in the test file. Tests inject fakes via constructor. No real platform channels or network calls in tests.
